verdict.rationale: vLLM's multi-LoRA support (vllm-docs-10) allows switching between LoRA adapters on a running server without restart, which partially addresses 'switching models,' but there is no evidence of a documented API or feature for hot-swapping distinct base models without restarting the server. missing for 10: explicit docs/API for loading/unloading full base models at runtime, independent/hands-on confirmation of live model switching, and any mention of a model-management endpoint beyond LoRA adapters.
